title: Fish bone from a piranha
description: The player drops a bomb beside a pool and runs back. The explosion breaks the pool's side, the water drains away, and the piranha left on the dry floor turns into a fish bone. He picks the bone up, jumps out of the pool and throws it at a snake, which it kills, breaking.
